newsitem.title: USA: Banc One to buy retail credit-card accounts.
newsitem.headline: Banc One to buy retail credit-card accounts.

text.p: First Data Retail Services, unit of of First Data Corp, and Banc One's Private Label Credit Services unit said Friday they signed an agreement for Banc One to buy certain retail credit card portfolios in which First Data owns the consumer receivables.
First Data will continue to provide, on an interim basis, processing and customer services for the sold portfolios, the companies said.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.

First Data Corp said its subsidiaries process about 35 million private label retail and oil credit card accounts. The portfolios to be sold include about one million retail establishment accounts, which represent the only credit card receivables owned by First Data Retail Services, the companies said.
